Both browser bundles use Three.js release 0.153.0 under the included [MIT license](THREE-LICENSE.txt). The classic renderer is the release's original `build/three.min.js`. The GLB loader is the release's `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js` and its `toTrianglesDrawMode` utility bundled as a classic IIFE with esbuild, with named imports from `three` resolved to the already-loaded `window.THREE`. No network, external texture service or compression decoder is required.
